_comment: Drift baseline for scripts/ci/check-third-party-notices-fresh.ts (CI job 'Third-Party Notices Freshness').  RETIRED 2026-09-02 — BOTH LISTS ARE INTENTIONALLY EMPTY, AND EMPTY IS THE CORRECT STATE.  WHAT THIS WAS. src/data/thirdPartyNotices.generated.json is generated (npm run license:notices:generate) but nothing ever ran that generator in CI, so it drifted from the dependency set for over a month with no signal. When the gate was added on 2026-08-30 it recorded two known-bad conditions rather than failing on inherited state and blacking out the Mergify queue: (1) 81 packages whose disclosure on the shipped /legal/third-party-notices page was wrong or missing (driftingNames), and (2) the generator refusing to write at all because the @img/sharp-libvips family was allowlist-cleared copyleft with no entry in scripts/security/third-party-notices.pinned.json (blockedPinnedNotices).  WHY IT IS EMPTY NOW. Both conditions were fixed by SCRUM-3553 + SCRUM-3559: the 14 production-band @img/sharp-* / @img/sharp-libvips-* packages now carry pinned notice entries, so the generator writes again, and the regenerated notices file is in sync with the dependency set. The gate itself flagged the leftover exemptions ('82 baseline entries are no longer drifting') — a stale exemption is a live hole, so they are removed rather than carried. The gate is now an EXACT assertion: any new drift, and any allowlist-cleared copyleft dep landing without a pinned notice, fails from day one.  DO NOT REPOPULATE THESE LISTS TO GET A PR GREEN. The fix for a failure here is to run `npm run license:notices:generate` and commit the regenerated file, or to add the missing pinned notice. Re-baselining is only legitimate for genuinely inherited, separately-owned drift, and it needs a written reason and an expiry in this file.  MATCHING IS BY PACKAGE NAME, NOT VERSION, and blockedPinnedNotices holds PLATFORM-INDEPENDENT family roots (see stripPlatformSuffix), not installed package names: npm installs @img/sharp-libvips-darwin-arm64 on a laptop and @img/sharp-libvips-linux-x64 on an ubuntu runner, and one recorded root has to match both.  Regenerate the payload for this file with: npx tsx scripts/ci/check-third-party-notices-fresh.ts --emit-baseline  expires is a hard stop, not a suggestion: past that date the gate fails on any inherited drift too. With both lists empty it has nothing to excuse, so it is retained only as the deadline on any future re-baselining.
_ownedBy: SCRUM-3553 / SCRUM-3559 — pinned sharp notices + regenerated notices file (was: 'Regenerate third-party notices (blocked by sharp)')
